\chapter{Boolean Analysis — Circuit Size}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.RazborovSmolensky.CircuitSize
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
\section{Overview}

This file identifies the layerwise gate count $\mathrm{gateCountBefore}$ accumulated by the
Razborov--Smolensky induction with the total circuit size $F.\mathrm{size}$ of a feed-forward
circuit, by writing both as the sum of the cardinalities of the non-input layers.  The
identification is then used to restate the polynomial-approximation existence theorems of the
previous chapter with their error bounds phrased directly in terms of the number of gates.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Index of a non-input layer]
\lean{ACP.gateLayerIdx}
\leanok
\uses{ACP.FeedForward}
For a feed-forward circuit $F$, a bound $d \le F.\mathrm{depth}$ and an index
$j : \mathrm{Fin}\,d$, the layer index $\mathrm{gateLayerIdx}\,F\,h_d\,j \in
\mathrm{Fin}(F.\mathrm{depth}+1)$ is $j+1$, i.e.\ the $(j+1)$-st node layer of $F$.  It packages the
non-input layers $1, \dots, d$ as indices into $F.\mathrm{nodes}$ so that they can be summed over.
\end{definition}

\begin{lemma}[Partial gate count as a sum of layer cardinalities]
\lean{ACP.gateCountBefore_eq_sum_cards}
\leanok
\uses{ACP.FeedForward, ACP.gateCountBefore, ACP.gateCountBefore_succ, ACP.gateLayerIdx}
Let $F$ be a feed-forward circuit with all node layers finite.  Then for every $d$ with
$d \le F.\mathrm{depth}$,
\[
\mathrm{gateCountBefore}\,F\,d
  \;=\; \sum_{j : \mathrm{Fin}\,d} \abs{F.\mathrm{nodes}(\mathrm{gateLayerIdx}\,F\,h_d\,j)},
\]
that is, the number of non-input gates in the first $d$ layers is the sum of the cardinalities of
those layers.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Circuit size as a sum of layer cardinalities]
\lean{ACP.size_eq_sum_cards}
\leanok
\uses{ACP.FeedForward, ACP.FeedForward.size}
For a feed-forward circuit $F$ with all node layers finite,
\[
F.\mathrm{size} \;=\; \sum_{d : \mathrm{Fin}\,F.\mathrm{depth}} \abs{F.\mathrm{nodes}(d+1)},
\]
so the total number of non-input gates equals the sum of the cardinalities of all non-input layers.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Full-depth gate count is the circuit size]
\lean{ACP.gateCountBefore_depth_eq_size}
\leanok
\uses{ACP.FeedForward, ACP.FeedForward.size, ACP.gateCountBefore, ACP.gateCountBefore_eq_sum_cards, ACP.gateLayerIdx, ACP.size_eq_sum_cards}
For a feed-forward circuit $F$ with all node layers finite, taking $d = F.\mathrm{depth}$ gives
\[
\mathrm{gateCountBefore}\,F\,F.\mathrm{depth} \;=\; F.\mathrm{size}.
\]
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Polynomial distribution for all outputs, size form]
\lean{ACP.exists_poly_distribution_for_circuit_outputs_size}
\leanok
\uses{ACP.ACp_GateOps, ACP.FeedForward, ACP.FeedForward.eval, ACP.FeedForward.onlyUsesGates, ACP.FeedForward.size, ACP.boolInput, ACP.circuitDegreeBound, ACP.exists_poly_distribution_for_circuit_outputs, ACP.gateCountBefore_depth_eq_size}
Let $p$ be prime and let $F$ be a feed-forward circuit with finite node layers and a finite output
type, all of whose gates lie in the $\mathrm{AC}^0[p]$ gate set.  For every $\ell$ there exist a
finite nonempty seed type $\mathrm{Seed}$ and polynomials
$P : \mathrm{Seed} \to \mathrm{out} \to \bbz/p[X_1,\dots,X_n]$ such that every $P_{s,o}$ has total
degree at most $\mathrm{circuitDegreeBound}\,p\,\ell\,F.\mathrm{depth}$, and for every Boolean input
$x$ the seeds on which some output node is computed incorrectly, i.e.\
$P_{s,o}(\mathrm{boolInput}_p(x)) \ne F.\mathrm{eval}(x)(o)$ for some $o$, satisfy
\[
\abs{\{s : \text{$s$ is bad for $x$}\}} \cdot 2^{\ell}
  \;\le\; F.\mathrm{size} \cdot \abs{\mathrm{Seed}}.
\]
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Polynomial distribution for a single output, size form]
\lean{ACP.exists_poly_distribution_for_circuit_one_size}
\leanok
\uses{ACP.ACp_GateOps, ACP.FeedForward, ACP.FeedForward.eval₁, ACP.FeedForward.onlyUsesGates, ACP.FeedForward.size, ACP.boolInput, ACP.circuitDegreeBound, ACP.exists_poly_distribution_for_circuit_one, ACP.gateCountBefore_depth_eq_size}
Same statement for a circuit with a unique output node: there exist a finite nonempty seed type
$\mathrm{Seed}$ and polynomials $P : \mathrm{Seed} \to \bbz/p[X_1,\dots,X_n]$, each of total degree
at most $\mathrm{circuitDegreeBound}\,p\,\ell\,F.\mathrm{depth}$, such that for every Boolean input
$x$ the number of seeds $s$ with
$P_s(\mathrm{boolInput}_p(x)) \ne F.\mathrm{eval}_1(x)$ obeys
\[
\abs{\{s : \text{$s$ is bad for $x$}\}} \cdot 2^{\ell}
  \;\le\; F.\mathrm{size} \cdot \abs{\mathrm{Seed}}.
\]
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Polynomial list for a single output, size form]
\lean{ACP.exists_poly_list_for_circuit_one_size}
\leanok
\uses{ACP.ACp_GateOps, ACP.FeedForward, ACP.FeedForward.eval₁, ACP.FeedForward.onlyUsesGates, ACP.FeedForward.size, ACP.boolInput, ACP.circuitDegreeBound, ACP.exists_poly_list_for_circuit_one, ACP.gateCountBefore_depth_eq_size}
The list formulation of the previous theorem: for a circuit $F$ with a unique output node whose
gates all lie in the $\mathrm{AC}^0[p]$ gate set, there is a nonempty list $Ps$ of polynomials in
$\bbz/p[X_1,\dots,X_n]$, each of total degree at most
$\mathrm{circuitDegreeBound}\,p\,\ell\,F.\mathrm{depth}$, such that for every Boolean input $x$ the
sublist of $P \in Ps$ with $P(\mathrm{boolInput}_p(x)) \ne F.\mathrm{eval}_1(x)$ satisfies
\[
\abs{\{P \in Ps : \text{$P$ is wrong at $x$}\}} \cdot 2^{\ell}
  \;\le\; F.\mathrm{size} \cdot \abs{Ps}.
\]
\end{theorem}
